input.quote: NOTWITHSTANDING THE FOREGOING, NOTHING IN THIS SECTION 16.5 IS INTENDED TO OR SHALL LIMIT OR RESTRICT THE AMOUNTS PAYABLE TO THIRD PARTIES UNDER THE INDEMNITIES PROVIDED PURSUANT TO ARTICLE 10, SECTIONS 16.1 AND 16.2 ABOVE; PROVIDED, FURTHER, THAT THE FOREGOING LIMITATION OF LIABILITY SHALL NOT APPLY IN THE CASE OF GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT.
input.rationale: Section 16.5 is only a mutual waiver of special, indirect, punitive, incidental and consequential damages, with carve-outs operating against that waiver alone. No monetary or fee-based aggregate cap exists anywhere in the Agreement, so both Parties' direct exposure — including Ono's broad product-liability indemnity under Section 16.1 — is unlimited; that fails the fallback on a material term. We therefore add one new Section 16.7 at the fallback level: a mutual aggregate cap of 12 months' amounts payable by Ono, with indemnification obligations under Sections 16.1 and 16.2, breach of confidentiality obligations, and gross negligence/willful misconduct expressly outside the cap. Per the verifier's point, I confirmed the caption at p0520 ("ARTICLE X CONFIDENTIALITY", with 10.1 "Confidential Information"), so Article X is the confidentiality article; the carve-out is nevertheless now drafted functionally ("breach of its confidentiality obligations under Article X (Confidentiality)") so the element does not depend on the cross-reference. Section 16.5 is left untouched. Preferred wording is not met (no USD 1,000,000 greater-of floor, "paid or payable", data protection/security, fraud, other-party IP carve-outs, or payment-obligations exclusion); we are targeting the fallback.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual aggregate liability cap of 12 months' amounts payable, with indemnities, confidentiality obligations and gross negligence/willful misconduct outside the cap.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement disclaims consequential damages but sets no aggregate cap, so both Parties' direct liability is unlimited. We have added a mutual cap at 12 months' amounts payable by Ono as new Section 16.7, keeping each Party's indemnification obligations, breach of its confidentiality obligations under Article X and gross negligence/willful misconduct outside the cap; this is our fallback position.

ops.text: 16.7 Limitation of Liability. Except with respect to each Party's indemnification obligations under Sections 16.1 and 16.2, either Party's breach of its confidentiality obligations under Article X (Confidentiality), and either Party's gross negligence or willful misconduct, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the fees and other amounts payable by Ono under this Agreement during the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the claim.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
